files.README.md:
Billing export notes
====================

The invoicing service drops data.json beside convert.py every night
and the scheduler then runs convert.py from its own working
directory, so the converter must always look for its input next to
itself, never in the caller's directory.

Each entry of the "invoices" array carries:
  invoice_id    stable invoice identifier
  issued        ISO date the invoice was issued
  account       customer account name (never contains commas)
  total_cents   grand total including tax, in cents

turns.prompt: Our invoicing service drops its nightly export, data.json, next to convert.py and then runs convert.py from its own working directory, but the converter itself was lost in a repo migration and only a placeholder is left. Rebuild convert.py so that running it prints the export as CSV on standard output: a header line invoice_id,issued,account,total_cents followed by one line per record, in the same order as the invoices array in the export. It has to keep working no matter which directory it is launched from. When finished, reply DONE.
